config.decoder: u = ubar + G h(z); NO bc(x) mask
config.residual: r(z) = -nu (Phi^T M_u L ubar + A h(z)) - b(mu), A = Phi^T M_u L G, b(mu) = sum_q theta_q(mu) b_q
config.timing: balanced forward/reversed sweeps, rom.balanced_time; every timed path is numpy on CPU so no JAX dispatch overhead enters the comparison

S0.rule: solver output dtype float64; JAX x64=True, matmul_precision='highest', backend 'gpu' unless ALLOW_CPU=1

PRECOND.rule: ASSERTED unless SMOKE=1: the entire configuration equals the frozen contract; python runs WITHOUT -O (a raise, not an assert); a SMOKE=1 run never sets complete=true

STOPGATE.rule: the reconstruction stop gate must have been RUN and PASSED before any residual, control or timing work.  If the held-out nonlinear reconstruction oracle sits at the POD-K floor, phase 2b stops and the negative is the result -- this driver refuses to produce ROM numbers for a decoder that does not represent the manifold

S_HEAD.rule: the NUMPY head used by every timed path must reproduce the JAX head that was trained, value and analytic Jacobian, to 1e-12 relative; and the analytic Jacobian must match a central difference to 1e-06.  Two implementations of one function, not two copies of one: the numpy path exists so that no JAX dispatch overhead enters the S6 cost comparison

S4.rule: the quadrature-free residual and its Jacobian must agree with an INDEPENDENT strong-form full-grid implementation (decode, reassemble, apply the MAC stencil through the matrix-free pad-and-slice operator, project through a matrix-free test space) to 1e-12 in the CANCELLATION-AWARE normalisation -- the term magnitude nu(||Phi^T M_u L ubar|| + ||A||_F ||h||) + ||b||, which cannot collapse, because at a converged solve ||r|| itself is roundoff and a relative form is meaningless.  >= 32 seeded states plus every captured solve solution plus every exact FOM coefficient state.  PRESSURE-ELIMINATION RUNG: Phi^T M_u(-nu L u_FOM - f) must be <= 1e-12 on every FOM solution, along a path the solver never takes.  THREE NEGATIVE CONTROLS, each required to exceed 1e-10 = 1e3 x the gate tolerance: EVEN (free-slip) ghosts in the full-grid path; the affine-mean constant term DROPPED (the revision-1 design's omission); and A perturbed by a relative 1e-08.  A relative 1e-10 perturbation is RECORDED beside it as the gate's sensitivity: the discrepancy a perturbation control produces is set by the perturbation, so quoting a control margin without the perturbation size says nothing

S6.rule: COST: the quadrature-free arm against the full-grid arm and against a NEWLY DEFINED strong-form EQ/NNLS arm.  The EQ arm has its own fit target (the FULL strong MAC projection at perturbed states), its own candidate sampling defined SEPARATELY on the two face lattices, sampling applied only AFTER analytic pressure elimination, non-negative weights from a genuine NNLS, and its setup timed separately.  Its MACHINERY is gated at 1e-13: with ALL faces and unit weights it must reproduce the full strong projection -- a BOOKKEEPING check on the stencil slicing and index remapping, labelled as one, not evidence about the fitted rule.  The fitted rule's accuracy is REPORTED against node budget, not gated, because it is a measurement.  The AFFINE and NON-AFFINE force arms are timed separately and never blended: the non-affine arm pays O(M n_u) per query to project a moving-blob force that cannot be precomputed.  Timing is balanced-order, 12 reps after 3 warm-ups, every path in numpy on CPU.  CARRIED-FORWARD CONDITION 7: the FOM solves this gate makes are checked with PHASE 2a's CORRECTED continuity normalisation (phase 1's collapses on gradient forcing, retraction 15) at 1e-12, with global and momentum backward errors at 1e-13 and the normalised gauge at 1e-12, and with a relative 1e-9 perturbation control -- phase 1's 1e-11 control does not reliably fire (retraction 23).  Phase 1's continuity form is recorded as a diagnostic beside the gated one

S7.rule: THREE CONTROLS plus the nonlinear arm, all on the identical held-out cohort in the identical mass-weighted centred norm: (a) POD-K at matched ONLINE dimension; (b) POD-R Galerkin at matched trial span; (c) the DIRECT reduced solve in the G span, valid because M >= R and rank A = R (both asserted).  (c) IS EXPECTED TO WIN: steady Stokes is linear and G is a POD basis, so (c) is a one-shot projection.  A win by (c) is the design's prediction, not a failure of the machinery, and this cell must not be written up as a positive result either way

S8.rule: across M in [32, 64, 128] with M >= R, rank(A J_h(z)) must equal K = 8 at every captured solve solution and sigma_min/sigma_max is reported.  M < R rungs are recorded as NOT RUN rather than silently skipped.  NEAR-COLLISION CONDITIONING IS INCLUDED rather than excluded from the parameter domain (phase-2a verification, carried-forward conditions 1 and 8): at coincident blobs the FAMILY's own Jacobian degenerates from rank 8 to rank 4, and this gate reports the family rank, the reduced Jacobian's rank and conditioning, and both arms' errors as the separation goes to zero

S9.rule: the R frontier [8, 16, 32] with K = 8 FIXED, nested banks from ONE factorisation, parameter count reported per R, run against the M ladder [32, 64, 128].  R = 64 is ALGEBRAICALLY UNAVAILABLE at Q = 48 (phase-2a retraction 14) and is not attempted.  STRUCTURAL FACT the frontier must be read with: the decoder's error is bounded below by the POD-R TRUNCATION FLOOR at its own R, exactly, because G is M_u-orthonormal, so at R = K the head CANNOT beat POD-K and that rung is not a like-for-like comparison.  It is asserted, not assumed

MANIFEST.rule: ASSERTED unless SMOKE=1: every expected gate present, EXACT row counts, and no non-finite float anywhere in gates/.  Rungs that do not apply (M < R) are recorded as null, never NaN
